clips.label: Before the appointment
clips.transcript: Worker to interpreter: We will discuss the appointment notice and the next step. Here are the terms used on the form. We have allowed time for each turn.
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: During the conversation
clips.transcript: Worker, addressing the person: What would you like us to understand about this appointment? The worker stops speaking while the interpreter conveys the question and the person responds.
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: Before leaving
clips.transcript: Worker: To check that I explained it clearly, how will this next step fit into your week? What should we clarify?
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: The discussion drifts
clips.transcript: Colleague: Some people here just do not understand inclusion. Another colleague starts defending their awareness.
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: The chair redirects
clips.transcript: Chair: Let us return to the packet. It arrived at the start of the meeting. Two people asked for reading time. What can we change about when it goes out?
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: The team records the next step
clips.transcript: Chair: Who can send the next draft early enough for review? Let us agree the arrangement and check on Friday whether people had usable preparation time.
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: Start with today
clips.transcript: Person: A long meeting will not work for me today. Worker: Here are our previous notes. What still fits, and what is most useful to discuss today?
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: Narrow the conversation
clips.transcript: Person: I want to settle the transport question. Worker: Let us focus on that and leave the other topics for an agreed next conversation.
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: Put the next step in a usable form
clips.transcript: Next-step card: Transport question — worker will check the available option; person prefers a written response; follow-up time to be agreed together.
clips.purpose: Synthetic narrated fictional conversation; play one moment and examine the corresponding question before continuing.

clips.label: Version one: language support comes too late
clips.transcript: Fictional example. An English-only voicemail says: Leave your name, phone number, and the reason for calling. We will call you back. The caller cannot understand this message. Language support is offered only after a return call. The first contact has already become a barrier.
clips.purpose: Describe the first-contact barrier; not a translated greeting.

clips.label: Version two: a supported route from the beginning
clips.transcript: Fictional example. A tested first-contact route helps the caller request their language and reach a staff member with qualified interpretation. No translated greeting is performed in this recording. In the supported conversation, the worker explains: I will keep responsibility for the next step. Let us confirm the language support you requested and the best way to contact you. What should we clarify before we continue? The intake owner checks that the route, staffing, and follow-up actually work.
clips.purpose: Describe an owned usable service route without pretending an English recording removes the original language barrier.
